what: Goswamis of Khardah (24 Parganas), descendants of Nityananda, divide the district into bhabuh mahals with faujdar and chharidar who collect fees for Vaishnava initiation, marriage and death rites (Re 1-6 per bhek). Vaishnava, not Daśanāmī.
quote: the district ... is divided into several divisions by tiie Goswamis of Khardah in the 24-Parganas, who are the descendants of Nityananda and are regarded as leaders of the Yaishnavas

what: Pilgrim road diverts pilgrims bound for Puri; Jagannath pilgrim traffic through Bankura, no ascetic orders named.
quote: There is also a circular road called the Pilgrim Road, as it was made, about 20 years ago, in order to divert the stream of pilgrims, which formerly passed through the centre of the town on the way to Puri
